Q: what is the difference between OpenCV 2.4.11 and 3.0.0 A:

In addition to the answers provided above, another important difference is that SIFT/SURF feature detection has been taken off the default openCV 3.0 package. Since they are patented, openCV has moved 'non-free' algorithms to a different package: 

opencv_contrib

Q: Entity Framework Core tools doesn't remember migrations folder when using multiple DB contexts A:

--output-dir is only for organizing your migration files. EF Core doesn't look at the folder when running database update; it looks for compiled migrations in the assembly.

I'd first run:

dotnet ef migrations list --context AssetsDevDbContext

If that returns nothing, EF Core isn't finding your migrations. In my experience, this is usually because the migration was created for a different DbContext, the wrong startup/project is being used, or the migration isn't being compiled into the assembly.

Also double-check that the generated migration has:

[DbContext(typeof(AssetsDevDbContext))]
